text:
```yaml
name: Link Checker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight

jobs:
  test-and-link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest -q --junitxml=pytest.xml

      - name: Post pytest results
        uses: pmeier/pytest-results-action@v0.7.2
        with:
          path: pytest.xml
          summary: true
          display-options: 'summary'
          fail-on-empty: false
          title: 'Pytest Results'

      - name: Run link checker
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
        with:
          args: '--exclude "https://dynamic-svg-service.com/.*"'
          debug: false
          fail: true
          failIfEmpty: false
          format: 'github'
          jobSummary: true
          lycheeVersion: 'latest'
          checkbox: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          workingDirectory: '.'
```
